suggestions.topic: Repricing finalization for Platåberget testnet launch
suggestions.rationale: Devnet-8/Platåberget launch is blocked on finalized repricing numbers. ACDE #242 set deadline for early August; ACDT was expected to decide launch timing. Full benchmark suite results were due 'next week' from July 30.

suggestions.topic: Hegota non-headliner proposals and scope finalization
suggestions.rationale: Proposal deadline was ~August 7 (before ACDC call). This is the first ACDE after deadline to review all submitted proposals and decide which move forward beyond PFI. 15+ EIPs are currently PFI'd for Hegota.

suggestions.topic: EIP-7928 BAL state access: resolve client implementation discrepancies
suggestions.rationale: Hive chain PR #1589 remains blocked due to client disagreements on EIP-7928 BAL contents at block 57. This is a spec correctness issue affecting devnet testing and must be resolved before Platåberget launch.

suggestions.topic: Platåberget testnet launch timing and readiness
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #242 expected ACDT to decide launch timing. This is the first ACDE after that decision point. Need confirmation of launch date and any remaining blockers beyond repricing.

suggestions.topic: EIP-2488 (deprecate CALLCODE) and EIP-8268 (storage routes) presentations
suggestions.rationale: Both EIP presentations were deferred due to presenter absence. EIP-2488 deferred from ACDE #239 (June 18); EIP-8268 PFI'd but presentation deferred from ACDE #241 (July 16). Both should be presented for full evaluation.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam EIP status: Review promotion and SFI criteria
suggestions.rationale: Seven Glamsterdam EIPs remain in Draft status requiring author approval to move to Review. Meta EIP-7773 cannot move to Review until all constituent EIPs are in Review. SFI promotion also blocked on confirming four testing milestone criteria.
Devnet-7 is running as public testnet for app developers. Need status update and confirmation of any issues. Devnet-8 scope and timeline depend on repricing finalization.

suggestions.topic: discv5-only mode implementation: ENR field support
suggestions.rationale: All EL clients need to return ENR fields in admin_nodeInfo RPC endpoint for discv5-only support. No follow-up since ACDE #242; check implementation status across clients.
